# Escape before deflect

`customer_support.df.self_service_deflection.escape_before_deflect` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Design the route to a human first, then place the self-service answer in front of it — never the reverse.

When the answer is designed first, the human route becomes whatever space is left, which is how it ends up at the bottom of a page behind an accordion. Designing the escape first makes obstruction a visible decision somebody has to argue for.
